scope.carrier: one declared finite exact model-world carrier
scope.order_convention: P <= Q means Q refines P and therefore retains at least every distinction retained by P
outside_scope: stochastic, continuous, approximate, or delayed-observation extensions
carrier-changing transport without an explicit common lift or typed map
standalone mathematical novelty of the factorization substrate

objects.task: A scientific responsibility alpha represented by a contract-complete response signature Sigma_alpha: Omega -> Y_alpha.
objects.representation: A retained map R: Omega -> Z with quotient Q_R induced by its fibers.
objects.exact_adequacy: R models alpha iff Sigma_alpha = f o R for some map f.

results.name: Contract-Indexed Representation Adequacy
equivalent_conditions: every R-fiber is contained in one alpha-equivalence class
ker(R) is a subset of ker(Sigma_alpha)

results.name: Task preorder and quotient monotonicity
results.definition: alpha <=task beta iff Sigma_alpha factors through Sigma_beta

results.name: Canonical-state reuse
results.statement: q_alpha models beta iff beta <=task alpha
results.firewall: Adequacy for a weaker task does not license reuse for a stronger task.

results.name: Incomparability and nontransport
results.statement: If alpha and beta are task-incomparable, q_alpha fails beta and q_beta fails alpha.
results.preferred_term: failure of order transport across incomparable task indices

results.name: Joint responsibility
results.kernel_identity: ker(Sigma_(alpha join beta)) = ker(Sigma_alpha) intersect ker(Sigma_beta)
results.quotient_identity: Q_(alpha join beta) = Q_alpha join Q_beta
results.adequacy_identity: R models (alpha join beta) iff R models alpha and R models beta
